messages.text: terraform plan keeps wanting to recreate my aws_lb_listener even though nothing changed. diff shows default_action order flipping

That usually happens when the provider returns the actions in a different order than your config declares them. Check whether you have multiple default_action blocks; Terraform compares them as an ordered list, so the API's order wins. Declaring them in the same order the API returns, sorted by their order attribute, normally stops the churn. Some people just add lifecycle { ignore_changes = [default_action] } and move on.
ignore_changes feels like a hack tbh

It is a bit of a blunt tool, since it would also hide real changes to the listener. Setting an explicit order value on each action and matching that order in the config is the cleaner fix. If you're on an old provider version, upgrading also helps; a few versions had a known ordering bug here.
ok setting explicit order fixed it. thx

messages.text: excel q: I have client names in col A and limit utilisation % in col C. want to highlight anyone above 85% in red and sort them on top

Select column C, then Home > Conditional Formatting > Highlight Cells Rules > Greater Than, enter 0.85 (or 85 if your values aren't formatted as percentages) and pick red fill. To bring them to the top, select the table and use Data > Sort by column C, largest to smallest.
and a count of how many are above 85?
Use =COUNTIF(C:C,">0.85"). If the column stores whole numbers like 87 instead of 0.87, change it to ">85". You can put it in a cell above the table so it updates as utilisation changes.

messages.text: can u help me make a weekly timetable? i have two jobs and keep double booking myself

Sure. Tell me the fixed hours for each job, your travel time, and anything else in the week that's non-negotiable: prayers, family time, exercise, sleep. I'll lay it out day by day and flag any clashes.
job 1: support team lead at Pitchline Sports, mon-fri 8am to 1pm, office in Ugoki. job 2: english tutor on LinguaLoop, 6-9pm mon wed fri, online from home

Got it. So on weekdays you're at Pitchline from 8 to 1, and on Monday, Wednesday and Friday you tutor from 6 to 9 in the evening. How long is your commute to Ugoki, and what do you do with the afternoons?
20 min on bike. afternoons are mostly free, i nap lol. i also go to the ground for cricket on tues and thurs evenings, thats my only exercise

Nice, that gives the week a decent shape. Draft: Mon/Wed/Fri: 7:30 leave, 8–1 Pitchline, afternoon free, 5:30 prep, 6–9 tutoring. Tue/Thu: 8–1 Pitchline, afternoon free, cricket in the evening. ok but saturdays i do the weekly CSAT report for Pitchline from home, takes like 2 hrs. forgot that

persona: Zuri Boateng, 30, Ghanaian content creator and freelance video editor in Berlin, renewing her residence permit

messages.text: I need a checklist for my Ausländerbehörde appointment. renewing my freelance residence permit (I'm Ghanaian, the current one runs out 28 Feb). appointment is Feb 3 at 9:00

Here's a solid checklist for a freelance permit renewal: passport and current permit, biometric photo, completed application form, proof of health insurance, rental contract and Anmeldung, recent invoices and bank statements, your last tax assessment if you have one, letters of intent from clients, and an income forecast. Bring originals plus one copy of everything.
I have 2 regular clients, a cooking channel and a fintech startup. do they need to write letters?

Yes, letters of intent (Absichtserklärungen) from both are very helpful: on their letterhead, signed, saying they plan to keep working with you and roughly how much. Ideally they're dated within the last few weeks. You could also ask a Steuerberater to prepare the income forecast so the numbers look credible.
Wiremu Fletcher, my tax advisor, is already doing the Ertragsvorschau 👍
Perfect, then you mainly need the two client letters and your up-to-date invoices. It's worth checking that the amounts in the letters roughly match his forecast.

messages.text: SQL help: har customer ka last 3 months ka rolling average recharge chahiye, postgres. table recharges(msisdn, recharge_date, amount)
lekin kuch customers ke beech mein months missing hain, wo 0 count hone chahiye

Us ke liye har customer ke liye months ki series generate karein aur LEFT JOIN karein: generate_series(min_month, max_month, interval '1 month') ko msisdn ke saath CROSS JOIN karein, phir recharges ko LEFT JOIN kar ke COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) lein. Window function wahi rahega.
